name: Manastorm Shattered Halls: Warbringer O'mrogg carries a Classic dungeon boss health budget
contract: Segment 760 runs Warbringer O'mrogg (16809), an expansion-1 template with the captured HealthModifier 46.
At level 60 that was 229,034 base health, about seven times the 32,046 median of the level 56-62 Classic
dungeon bosses. Manastorm now rebases Burning Crusade dungeon creatures on the Classic base-health column and
removes the 37.95 / 11.5 boss modifier gap before depth scaling, so his base health is 42,543. With the solo
multipliers that put Marisa du'Paige between 70,000 and 110,000, the old budget lies above 120,000.
